card.text: Explore Thebe with Galileo imagery and its source-backed irregular shape.

introduction.text: Thebe is a small, irregular moon inside Io’s orbit. Its battered surface includes the enormous crater Zethus, and dust from impacts feeds Jupiter’s faint outer gossamer ring.

normal.title: SSI mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading without measuring albedo. The gray grid marks missing or unreliable images.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Galileo-model height relative to a 49.3 km sphere. Unseen terrain is modeled; depressions may be exaggerated.
